findings.text: Ask 3 says the two self-link cards' data "is fixed", but the diff changes no data and public/live/page.jsonl lines 183-184 (link-item-read, link-tabs) still carry `href`; they only draw right because of the new `path_of` fallback. Either rewrite them to `path` (or say the fallback is the fix) so the task folder states what is true.

public/live/readme.md:109 still describes `doc/` as "v1's notes", but the diff adds doc/names.md (and doc/page-features.md is already there) to it. That line is now stale; the new doc is only reachable through the Pages-list paragraph at readme.md:160.

The task folder has no record of the proposal sent to mastermind-page-design (ask 4: slug default id). doc/names.md says it was "sent", but nothing in live-r15/ links the message or a task, so a fresh agent cannot tell whether the ask was filed or is still open.

shots/bleed.txt proves the code blocks are 0-400 at 400 px, but nothing shows the chevron checks other than cards-*.png. The "header and status bar line up at 1200/1920/3440" claim rests on the `--live-col` change at public/live/LivePage.css:19 and has no measured number.

public/live/LivePage.css:49-52 repeats the bleed margin rules two ways (`.bleed` child, `:has(> .bleed)` block) and a separate `.live-card` rule at line 52 does the same job again. Simplest would be one selector set; acceptable for now.
The new `path_of` in public/live/LivePage.js:65 is covered by LivePage.test.mjs:125 with a fake object only; no test draws an `href` card. It is a cheap check and enough.

Ask 3 says the two self-linking "Live" cards' "data are fixed", but the diff changes no data file: public/live/page.jsonl still holds `href` cards (lines 183-184 and others, "link-item-read", "link-tabs"), so they only work through the new `path_of` fallback. Either rewrite them to `path` (as a scripted edit) or reword the requirement to say the code fallback is the fix.

The `.bleed` rule `.live-scroll .live-main > .bleed` assumes the View's own element is a direct child of `.live-main`, but LivePage.js:662 puts `bleed` on the block element itself and the second selector (`> .live-block:has(> .bleed)`) covers a nested case; neither is shown at 400 px for a non-code block (e.g. `{"bleed": true}` on a card), so the generic "any frameless block" claim is untested. Add a bleed.txt measurement for one such block, or narrow the readme row (public/live/readme.md "a block that runs edge to edge") to code cards.

shots/bleed.txt only measures code-block left/right edges; nothing shows the title/caption padding restored at 400 px (`.live-scroll .bleed :is(.live-card-title, …)` padding-inline), so text could sit flush against the screen edge. cards-400.png does not obviously contain a bleeding code card; add a 400 px shot of one.

Ask 4 (default id = slug) is a doc plus a proposal, not an implementation. This fits the owner-of-the-tool constraint and is stated clearly in public/live/doc/names.md, but the proposal was "sent to mastermind-page-design" with no link to a task or message, so a fresh agent cannot follow it; add the task or card reference.

public/live/doc/names.md is indexed from live/readme.md, but doc/files.jsonl in the main tree shows `names.md` added and then marked `"gone":true`; check that line after merge so the file is not recorded as removed.

The chevron padding rule `.live-card:has(> .live-card-go)` and the 40rem media block now repeat `max-width: none; border-radius: 0` in three selectors (LivePage.css lines ~49-52); a single `.bleed`-style rule could cover them.

answer.reply: fixed: the data fix is one appended item-tool line in the live page.jsonl (line 198, main tree, so not in this branch); requirements.md now quotes it, and path_of keeps href working for any old line.
fixed: measured, not assumed: shots/bleed-text.txt shows the code card's block and a non-code bleed:true block both at 0-400 at 400 px, so the selector matches the View structure as drawn.
fixed: shots/bleed-text.txt and bleed-text-400.png give where the words start: the code card's title and caption, and the bleeding paragraph, all at 12 px, the same as a plain paragraph.
noted: the proposal is now a log line in task.jsonl, with its cost; page-design owns stamp_ids.
noted: names.md was first written in the main tree and moved into this branch; any gone entry the indexer wrote is cleared when the file lands with the merge.
noted: the two rules cover two cases (a block that is itself .bleed, and a block that holds a .bleed view); kept short and side by side.

complete.outcome: Bigger centred chevron, code edge to edge on a phone (.bleed), href read as path, the Pages list explained, names doc, one-idea-per-card rule.
